docs.summary: Intent-tagged box-shadow helpers. A box-shadow is either a dark elevation **drop shadow** or an accent-tinted **glow**; these read identically to Paper but carry the caller's intent so each can be toggled independently via [`DropShadowsEnabled`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.Origami~DropShadowsEnabled) / [`GlowsEnabled`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.Origami~GlowsEnabled). When the corresponding effect is disabled the shadow is simply not applied.
